sentences.en: jacinta : Hello, Easy Life Cleaning Services, Jacinta speaking
sentences.zh: JACINTA: 您好，这里是易生活清洁服务公司，我是杰辛塔。

sentences.en: client : Oh hello
sentences.zh: CLIENT: 哦，您好。

sentences.en: I'm looking for a cleaning service for my apartment – do you do domestic cleaning?
sentences.zh: 我在为我的公寓寻找一家清洁服务公司——你们提供家庭清洁服务吗？

sentences.en: jacinta : Sure
sentences.zh: JACINTA: 当然可以。

sentences.en: client : Well, it's just a one-bedroom flat
sentences.zh: CLIENT: 嗯，这只是间一居室的公寓。

sentences.en: Do you have a basic cleaning package?
sentences.zh: 你们有基础清洁套餐吗？

sentences.en: jacinta : Yes
sentences.zh: JACINTA: 有的。

sentences.en: For a one-bedroom flat we're probably looking at about two hours for a clean
sentences.zh: 针对一居室公寓，我们通常需要大约两个小时来完成一次清洁。

sentences.en: So we'd do a thorough clean of all surfaces in each room, and polish them where necessary
sentences.zh: 我们会彻底清洁每个房间内所有表面，并在必要时进行抛光。

sentences.en: Does your apartment have carpets?
sentences.zh: 您的公寓铺有地毯吗？

sentences.en: client : No, I don't have any, but the floor would need cleaning
sentences.zh: CLIENT: 没有，我那里没有地毯，但地板需要清洁。

sentences.en: jacinta : Of course – we'd do that in every room
sentences.zh: JACINTA: 当然可以——我们会清洁每个房间的地板。

sentences.en: And we'd do a thorough clean of the kitchen and bathroom
sentences.zh: 同时，我们也会对厨房和浴室进行彻底清洁。

sentences.en: client : OK
sentences.zh: CLIENT: 好的。

sentences.en: jacinta : Then we have some additional services which you can request if you want – so for example, we can clean your oven for you every week
sentences.zh: JACINTA: 此外，我们还提供一些可选的附加服务——例如，我们可以每周为您清洁烤箱。

sentences.en: client : Actually, I hardly ever use that, but can you do the fridge?
sentences.zh: CLIENT: 其实我几乎从不使用烤箱，但你们能帮我清洁冰箱吗？

sentences.en: jacinta : Sure
sentences.zh: JACINTA: 当然可以。

sentences.en: Would you like that done every week?
sentences.zh: 您希望每周都做这项服务吗？

sentences.en: client : Yes, definitely
sentences.zh: CLIENT: 是的，一定要。

sentences.en: And would ironing clothes be an additional service you can do?
sentences.zh: 那么熨烫衣物也是你们可提供的附加服务吗？

sentences.en: jacinta : Yes, of course
sentences.zh: JACINTA: 是的，当然可以。

sentences.en: client : It wouldn't be much, just my shirts for work that week
sentences.zh: CLIENT: 工作服衬衫数量不多，就只是当周穿的几件而已。

sentences.en: jacinta : That's fine
sentences.zh: JACINTA: 没问题。

sentences.en: And we could also clean your microwave if you want
sentences.zh: 如果您需要，我们还可以清洁微波炉。

sentences.en: client : No, I wipe that out pretty regularly so there's no need for that
sentences.zh: CLIENT: 不用了，我经常擦拭，所以没必要。

sentences.en: jacinta : We also offer additional services that you might want a bit less often, say every month
sentences.zh: JACINTA: 我们还提供一些您可能不需要太频繁使用的附加服务，比如每月一次。

sentences.en: So for example, if the inside of your windows need cleaning, we could do that
sentences.zh: 例如，如果您的窗户内侧需要清洁，我们可以为您处理。

sentences.en: client : Yes, that'd be good
sentences.zh: CLIENT: 是的，这很好。

sentences.en: I'm on the fifteenth floor, so the outside gets done regularly by specialists, but the inside does get a bit grubby
sentences.zh: 我住在十五楼，因此窗户外部会由专业人员定期清洁，但内侧确实有点脏。

sentences.en: jacinta : And we could arrange for your curtains to get cleaned if necessary
sentences.zh: JACINTA: 如果需要，我们也可以安排清洁您的窗帘。

sentences.en: client : No, they're OK
sentences.zh: CLIENT: 不用了，窗帘目前还好。

sentences.en: But would you be able to do something about the balcony?
sentences.zh: 不过，你们能帮忙处理一下阳台吗？

sentences.en: It's quite small and I don't use it much, but it could do with a wash every month or so
sentences.zh: 它很小，我也不怎么使用，但大概每月清洗一次会比较好。

sentences.en: jacinta : Yes, we can get the pressure washer onto that
sentences.zh: JACINTA: 是的，我们可以用高压水枪来清洗。

sentences.en: jacinta : Now if you're interested, we do offer some other possibilities to do with general maintenance
sentences.zh: JACINTA: 现在，如果您感兴趣的话，我们还提供一些与日常维护相关的其他服务选项。

sentences.en: For example, if you have a problem with water and you need a plumber in a hurry, we can put you in touch with a reliable one who can come out straightaway
sentences.zh: 例如，如果您遇到水管问题，急需一位可靠的水管工，我们可以立即为您联系一位能马上上门的师傅。

sentences.en: And the same thing if you need an electrician
sentences.zh: 同样地，如果您需要电工，我们也能提供相应协助。

sentences.en: client : Right
sentences.zh: CLIENT: 明白了。

sentences.en: That's good to know
sentences.zh: 这很有帮助。

sentences.en: I've only just moved here so I don't have any of those sorts of contacts
sentences.zh: 我才刚搬来这里，还没有这类人脉资源。

sentences.en: jacinta : And I don't know if this is of interest to you, but we also offer a special vacuum cleaning system which can improve the indoor air quality of your home by capturing up to 99% of all the dust in the air
sentences.zh: jacinta : 而且我不知道这是否会引起您的兴趣，但我们还提供一种特殊的吸尘清洁系统，可通过捕获空气中高达99%的灰尘来改善您家中的室内空气质量。

sentences.en: So if you're troubled by allergies, this can make a big difference
sentences.zh: 所以，如果您受过敏问题困扰，这将带来很大改善。

sentences.en: client : Right
sentences.zh: client : 好的。

sentences.en: In fact, I don't have that sort of problem, but I'll bear it in mind
sentences.zh: 事实上，我本人并没有这类问题，但我会把这点记在心里。

sentences.en: Now can you tell me a bit about your cleaning staff?
sentences.zh: 那么，您能向我简单介绍一下你们的清洁人员吗？

sentences.en: jacinta : Of course
sentences.zh: jacinta : 当然可以。

sentences.en: So all our cleaners are very carefully selected
sentences.zh: 我们所有的清洁人员都经过非常严格的筛选。

sentences.en: When they apply to us, they have to undergo a security check with the police to make sure they don't have any sort of criminal background, and, of course, they have to provide references as well
sentences.zh: 当他们向我们申请职位时，必须接受警方的安全背景审查，以确保其没有任何犯罪记录；当然，他们还需提供推荐信。

sentences.en: Then if we think they might be suitable for the job, we give them training for it
sentences.zh: 然后，如果我们认为他们可能适合该岗位，便会为他们提供岗前培训。

sentences.en: That lasts for two weeks so it's very thorough, and at the end of it, they have a test
sentences.zh: 培训为期两周，内容非常全面；培训结束时，他们还需通过一项考核。

sentences.en: If they pass that, we take them on, but we monitor them very carefully – we ask all our clients to complete a review of their performance after every visit and to email it to us
sentences.zh: 如果他们顺利通过考核，我们便会正式聘用他们；但我们会对其进行非常严密的监督——我们要求所有客户每次服务结束后都填写一份关于其工作表现的评价，并通过电子邮件发送给我们。

sentences.en: So we can pick up any problems straightaway and deal with them
sentences.zh: 这样我们就能立即发现任何问题并及时处理。

sentences.en: client : OK, well that all sounds good
sentences.zh: client : 好的，听起来都很不错。

sentences.en: And will I always have the same cleaner?
sentences.zh: 那我以后会一直由同一位清洁人员服务吗？

sentences.en: jacinta : Yes, we do our best to organise it that way, and we usually manage it
sentences.zh: jacinta : 是的，我们会尽力安排如此，而且通常都能做到。

sentences.en: client : Good
sentences.zh: client : 很好。

sentences.en: That's fine
sentences.zh: 这没问题。

sentences.en: Right, so I'd like to go ahead and …
sentences.zh: 好的，那么我想现在就……
